description.zh: 用无头浏览器打开一个网页并返回其可见文本（会执行 JS，适合普通 http_request 抓不到内容的动态页面）。仅公网地址；可选 CSS 选择器只取某区域。
description.en: Open a web page in a headless browser and return its visible text (executes JS — for dynamic pages plain http_request can't read). Public addresses only; optional CSS selector to scope the extraction.

selector.description: 可选 CSS 选择器，默认 body
optional CSS selector, defaults to body
